responsibility: Defines the AVX10.2 min/max intrinsic API for 128-bit and 256-bit vectors plus scalar lane forms. It provides configurable min/max operations for BF16, FP16, FP32, and FP64 data, including masked and explicit-rounding forms for packed vectors and scalar `sd`/`ss`/`sh` operations, serving as the narrow-width counterpart to the AVX10.2-512 min/max header.
